We have target molecule: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

We applied template 20810 gave two precursors: a carbamate-protected piperazine attached to aromatic core, and a sulfonyl chloride aryl (Cl-SO2-Ph-F). The first precursor is not buyable (False). The second is buyable (True). Need to find buyable precursors for the first fragment.

We need to break down the first fragment further. That fragment is: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1

We need to find retrosynthetic steps to get to commercially available chemicals, total steps <=6, total cost <=9999 (we don't have cost data, assume buyable cheap). So we need to further dissect that fragment.

We can search for templates that break the carbamate (C(=O)O-tBu) or the N-aryl bond.

We have template 431080 which breaks carbamate into phenol and tBu-O-? Actually retro: [C:1]-[O;H0;D2;+0:2]-[c] -> gives [C:1]-[OH] and aromatic O-CH2-... plus O-C-C-N1... So applying to our molecule gave product: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(C2=C(O)C=CC=C2)CC1? Wait earlier apply gave product with O-? Actually result from apply_template 431080 gave product: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc(CCC3(O)CCC3)c2OCCN2CCOCC2)CC1 (maybe). Let's reapply to see actual output.
